lessons: Keep hooks extremely punchy: the video with a descriptive hook line ('Why Cold Water Fails Against Spicy Food 🌶️🥛') experienced a massive 22.7% drop at the 10% mark, underperforming similar videos at the start (0.33 vs typical 0.5).

Avoid trailing off into secondary questions near the end: the highest end-drop (11.6% at 94%) occurred immediately after introducing an auxiliary question ('Ever thought why drinking an ice-cold fruit juice won't stop spicy food burn either?').

Maintain consistent pacing through the first quarter: across all videos, the sharpest drop-offs happen predictably between 10% and 26% into the runtime, indicating that elaborate setups lose audience attention.
Prioritize early retention mechanics over mid-video explanations, as all analyzed videos suffer steep drops (over 10-25%) within the first quarter regardless of topic.
worst_moment_types: Introductory lines describing the premise rather than immediately escalating the tension
Secondary rhetorical questions near the conclusion that disrupt the flow before the final payoff
best_hook_types: Not enough data to isolate specific positive hook types, as all tested videos underperformed against similar YouTube content at the start (0.33 to 0.46 vs 0.5 baseline).
